title: Distribution-Free Uncertainty Quantification for Kernel Methods by Gradient Perturbations
abstract: arXiv:1812.09632v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We propose a data-driven approach to quantify the uncertainty of models constructed by kernel methods. Our approach minimizes the needed distributional assumptions, hence, instead of working with, for example, Gaussian processes or exponential families, it only requires knowledge about some mild regularity of the measurement noise, such as it is being symmetric or exchangeable. We show, by building on recent results from finite-sample system identification, that by perturbing the residuals in the gradient of the objective function, information can be extracted about the amount of uncertainty our model has. Particularly, we provide an algorithm to build exact, non-asymptotically guaranteed, distribution-free confidence regions for ideal, noise-free representations of the function we try to estimate. translated_title: 基于梯度扰动的核方法无分布不确定性量化
translated_abstract: 我们提出了一种数据驱动的方法来量化由核方法构建的模型的不确定性。我们的方法最大限度地减少了所需的分布假设，因此，不同于使用高斯过程或指数族等模型，它只需要了解测量噪声的一些温和的正则性，例如噪声是对称的或可交换的。我们基于有限样本系统辨识的最新结果表明，通过扰动目标函数梯度中的残差，可以提取关于我们模型不确定性程度的信息。特别地，我们提供了一种算法，为我们试图估计的函数的理想无噪声表示构建精确的、非渐近保证的、无分布的置信区域。对于典型的凸二次问题和对称噪声，这些区域是以给定的标称估计为中心的星形凸区域，并且……
tldr: 该论文提出一种通过扰动目标函数梯度中残差的数据驱动方法，在仅需假设测量噪声具有对称性或可交换性等温和正则性的条件下，为核方法估计的函数构建精确的、非渐近保证的无分布置信区域。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a data-driven approach that perturbs residuals in the objective function's gradient to construct exact, non-asymptotically guaranteed, distribution-free confidence regions for kernel methods, requiring only mild regularity assumptions on the measurement noise such as symmetry or exchangeability.
